evals.question: What requirement does the document state for diagnosis?
evals.expected_answer: Patients must have undergone careful screening, evaluation, and diagnosis by a multidisciplinary team prior to thermal destruction of the intraosseous BVN (such screening must include psychological, as well as physical evaluation).

evals.question: According to the document, how is treatment and effective described?
evals.expected_answer: In a prospective, randomized, multicenter study of intraosseous basivertebral nerve ablation for the treatment of chronic low back pain conducted by Khalil et. al (2019), comparison of the effectiveness of intraosseous RF ablation of the BVN to standard care for the treatment of chronic LBP in a specific subgroup of patients suspected to have vertebrogenic related symptomatology was evaluated.
evals.evidence_quote: In a prospective, randomized, multicenter study of intraosseous basivertebral nerve ablation for the treatment of chronic low back pain conducted by Khalil et. al (2019), comparison of the effectiveness of intraosseous RF ablation of the BVN to standard care for the treatment of chronic LBP in a specific subgroup of patients suspected to have vertebrogenic related symptomatology was evaluated.
